newsitem.title: USA: Digital Systems holders OK ViewStar merger.
newsitem.headline: Digital Systems holders OK ViewStar merger.

text.p: Digital Systems International Inc said Monday its shareholders had approved the issuance of shares of Digital common to shareholders of ViewStar Corp.
The approval will permit Digital to complete its merger with ViewStar, which it anticipates doing around December 24, it said.
It said it previously announced plans to sell up to 300,000 additional shares of Digital stock, if necessary, in order to complete the merger.
It said today that it would not be necessary to sell the additional shares and the registration statement for the shares will be withdrawn.
